Kalimera from Honey Pearls!

A little reminder that we’ll be joining the Late Night Shopping fun next Thursday and Friday! 🛍️✨

We’ll be keeping our doors open until 8pm on both evenings, so why not pop in for a warm coffee, a little treat or something delicious to bite into? ☕🥐

And there’s more! Enjoy 15% OFF all our wraps on both days! 🌯❤️
(Doesn’t apply on Deliveroo)

Whether you’re taking a shopping break or just fancy a little pick-me-up, we’d love to see you!
See you at Honey Pearls! 💛

ΚΑΛΟ ΜΗΝΑ !

May November bring good health, peace and happiness, love to you and your families 🤍💙

Let the aromas of cinnamon, cloves and roasted walnuts warm up your heart in this beautiful autumn Sunday 🍂
